events.description: A large group of people engaged in violent unrest on a street, with individuals throwing objects, running, and clashing; debris is scattered on the ground and vehicles are surrounded by agitated crowds.
Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat near the white pickup truck; at least two distinct pairs are seen grappling and striking each other.

Large crowd surges around vehicles and houses, with widespread throwing of debris (cups, bottles), chaotic movement, and multiple simultaneous physical altercations; environment shows signs of collective violent unrest beyond isolated fights.

White pickup truck appears to have struck or collided with a parked vehicle or object on the left side; initial frame (f0) shows motion blur and abnormal positioning suggesting impact, though exact contact point is obscured by crowd and motion.

A man in a black long-sleeve shirt and white pants is captured mid-motion, throwing an object (likely a can or bottle) with force toward a group of people off-frame to the right; his posture indicates aggressive intent and physical exertion.

A man in a plaid shirt repeatedly throws objects (cans/bottles) at others; frames f7–f14 show him winding up, releasing, and following through; frame f15 shows two individuals actively throwing items at each other amid scattered debris, indicating mutual engagement.

Sustained collective violent unrest: multiple individuals engage in throwing projectiles, debris litters the street, and law enforcement in riot gear is present and forming lines (f1–f6), indicating escalation beyond isolated conflict into group-level disorder.

Two individuals engage in a physical altercation: the man in the plaid shirt throws an object (likely a can) at the other man, who then retaliates by throwing an object back; they circle each other and continue exchanging thrown items and aggressive gestures across multiple frames.
Multiple individuals engaged in mutual physical combat: one man in black shirt grapples with another, while others join in punching and shoving; visible in frames f0–f4.

Escalation to collective violent unrest: large group actively involved in chaotic melee, throwing objects, kicking debris, with bystanders on porch observing; ground littered with cans and signs; frames f2–f5 show widespread participation and disorder beyond isolated fighting.
A person in dark clothing is seen on the ground being kicked by multiple individuals (e.g., red cap, grey hoodie), suggesting a helpless victim being attacked; visible in f5 and f6.

A large group of people engaged in collective violent unrest, including throwing objects (e.g., bottles/cans), aggressive posturing, and chaotic movement in a residential street; police officers are present but not actively intervening in the immediate violence.

At least two individuals engage in mutual physical combat: one person in red shirt lunges and swings at another, who ducks and retaliates with a swing; others nearby observe or participate peripherally.

Two individuals in the street engage in mutual physical combat: one in a gray hoodie and red backpack lunges and swings at another in a dark jacket, who blocks and counters; their movements are reciprocal and aggressive.

A group of people in the street exhibits collective violent unrest: debris is scattered on the ground, multiple individuals are actively moving aggressively, shouting, and engaging in physical altercations, with bystanders observing or participating in the chaos.
Two men engage in a physical fight in the street near a white pickup truck; one man in a grey top throws punches while the other in dark clothing defends and retaliates.

A separate fight erupts involving a man in a light blue checkered shirt and a man in a pink shirt; they exchange blows and grapple, with the man in blue appearing to throw a punch or swing an object (possibly a pole) around 66.0–66.5s.

A large crowd gathers on a residential street, with individuals actively throwing objects (e.g., bottles/cans) and moving aggressively; debris is scattered across the ground, and people are seen running and clashing in groups, indicating collective violent unrest.

In the early frames, two individuals near the chain-link fence engage in mutual physical combat: one raises a long object (possibly a bat or pole) while another confronts them; others surround and appear to participate or intervene, consistent with hand-to-hand or weapon-assisted fighting.

Large crowd of people engaged in chaotic, disorderly movement on a residential street; debris (cups, bottles) scattered across road and sidewalk; individuals running, shoving, and clustering aggressively near houses and vehicles; consistent visual evidence of collective violent unrest over the full interval.

At least two individuals in center-left of frame (f5–f7) are seen in close physical contact with aggressive postures: one person appears to be pushing or striking another who is recoiling; motion blur suggests rapid impact; consistent with mutual physical combat.

In frames f13–f15, a cluster of individuals near the center-right shows dynamic physical engagement: one person in red cap appears to swing an arm toward another while others surround them in tight proximity; motion blur and body orientation suggest active mutual combat.

Large crowd engaged in chaotic, disorderly behavior on a residential street; individuals are running, throwing objects (evidenced by airborne debris and scattered litter), and some are climbing onto vehicles and structures. The scene shows collective unrest with no clear authority presence, consistent with a riot.
